title: Fixture
description: A hand-made piece of Battlefield, drawn as ASCII art, that generation stamps in. A base holds the defender's Command Post, building sites and unit starts; a feature is a landmark placed in open space.

replace.description: Replace an existing definition with this id.

kind.description: base: the defender's, holding its Command Post; feature: a landmark.

faction.description: A base's Faction: it's the base when that Faction defends. A base without one is a neutral garrison's, and anyone's if their Faction has none.

archetypes.description: The Battlefield Archetypes it can appear in; left out, any.

weight.description: How often it's picked among those that fit, against the others' weights. Defaults to 1.

rotate.description: Whether generation may turn it a quarter, half or three quarters.

key.description: What each character in map is. A character that's in neither key nor markers leaves the Battlefield as it is; a marker's cell is made clear.

additionalProperties.title: Fixture Cell
additionalProperties.description: Exactly one of terrain, clear (the preset's clear ground) or cover (its point cover), so a fixture suits any preset; height, if given, sets the height level.

markers.description: Characters that place something, on an open cell: commandPost (a base's one), site (a building site), unitStart (where a defending Stack deploys, in order), pad (a build pad), cover (the preset's point cover).

map.description: Its cells, row by row, top first; every row the same length.
